title: The Last Stair
text: One stair left, narrow and dark, its steps worn hollow by things that were not feet. At the top, the thing you came to kill is waiting. You can hear it breathing. Whoever goes first will meet its first blow alone.

options.label: The hardiest goes up first, to take its first blow so the rest of you need not.

outcomes.text: They take the first blow on their shield and their body, and stay standing. The rest come up behind them whole, and ready.

options.label: Go up together, shoulder to shoulder, and let it choose who it strikes.

outcomes.text: Shoulder to shoulder, no one first, no one last, up into the breathing dark.
